quarterly_data.signal: Amazon's Q2 2026 earnings release gives company-wide (consolidated: North America, International and AWS segments together, not AWS-specific) third quarter 2026 guidance: net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025 (nearly 400 basis points higher excluding the impact of Prime Day in both years), and operating income is expected to be between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion, compared with $17.4 billion in third quarter 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 net sales $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion (+9% to 12% YoY); operating income $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion (vs $17.4 billion in Q3 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: The release's AWS segment tables (in millions) show AWS net sales of $79,819 for the six months ended June 30, 2026 versus $60,140 a year earlier (33% Y/Y), with six-month AWS operating income of $30,782 versus $21,707. Trailing-twelve-month AWS net sales were $148,404 as of Q2 2026 (28% Y/Y).
quarterly_data.figure: AWS six months ended June 30, 2026: net sales $79,819M vs $60,140M (33% Y/Y), operating income $30,782M vs $21,707M; AWS TTM net sales $148,404M at Q2 2026 (28% Y/Y)
